quotes.title: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
quotes.description: The Bachelor of Science in Computer Science is a four-year, 240 ECTS program that combines a strong foundation in computer science, mathematics, and natural sciences with practical learning and opportunities to explore emerging technologies.

programme.school_as_published: School of Computing and Artificial Intelligence
programme.how_found: WebSearch 'nu.edu.kz sprogram "Computer Science" Bachelor of Science program page Nazarbayev University' -> nu.edu.kz regular-admissions page link 'All Programs (A-Z)' -> https://nu.edu.kz/admissions/programs/ filtered keyword=Computer -> entry 'Bachelor of Science in Computer Science / School of Computing and Artificial Intelligence / Level: Undergraduate / Language: English / Delivery mode: Full time, on-campus / Duration: 4 years' -> link to scai.nu.edu.kz/bsc-cs
programme.notes: The request names the School of Engineering and Digital Sciences, but the official programme catalogue (nu.edu.kz/admissions/programs/) and the programme page footer now place the BSc in Computer Science under the School of Computing and Artificial Intelligence (scai.nu.edu.kz). The SEDS URL https://seds.nu.edu.kz/bachelor_of_scs returned HTTP 404 and old-seds.nu.edu.kz returned no content. The catalogue description still begins 'The B.Eng. in Computer Science program develops a strong foundation...' while the title everywhere is 'Bachelor of Science in Computer Science'. On the programme page the label and value ('Campus', 'Astana, Kazakhstan') sit in separate markup elements, so spacing around the colon varies by renderer.

english.quote: IELTS – 6.0;* writing -6.0; reading & listening & speaking – 5.5 or the equivalent TOEFL score as posted on the ETS website;
english.how_found: WebSearch 'Nazarbayev University undergraduate admission requirements IELTS TOEFL NUET SAT' -> Regular Admissions page -> section 'Admission Requirements' > 'Undergraduate' > 'English Proficiency Test'. Quote lines joined with single spaces (they are separate lines in the page table).
english.notes: Applies to all applicants (domestic and international) for direct admission to undergraduate programs; same thresholds appear on the Financial aid & Scholarships page and in the Admission Policy and Procedures (№ 38-н/қ, 11.03.2026, Appendix 1): 'UG IELTS results no less than 6.0 overall (writing - 6.0, listening - 5.5, reading - 5.5, speaking - 5.5) TOEFL results The equivalent TOEFL score as posted on the ETS website'. No numeric TOEFL iBT total is published (only 'equivalent TOEFL score as posted on the ETS website'), so toefl_ibt is omitted. Footnote on the same page: '*An overall IELTS score of 5.5 (with no subscore below 5.5) may be considered for conditional admission. Applicable only to regular admission.' Foundation Year (NUFYP) thresholds, same page: 'IELTS – 5.5;* writing & reading – 5.5, listening & speaking – 5.0' with conditional admission possible at IELTS 5.0 (no subscore below 5.0). Olympiad-winners financial-support category: 'IELTS/TOEFL scores are required, but there is no minimum score.' Remote tests (IELTS Online, TOEFL iBT Home Edition, TOEFL PDT) are not accepted; no superscoring; certificates must be valid on August 1, 2027; IELTS One Skill Retake accepted. Non-degree study (not relevant here) lists IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 79.

value.description: Regular (fee-paying) admission requires ONE of: GPA 4.0 out of 5.0; UNT in English overall 85 with 8/10 mathematical literacy and 8/10 reading literacy; Digital SAT 1240 or ACT 26; IB Diploma 27 with 4,4,4 in three HL subjects; or A-level/NIS Grade 12 Certificate not less than BBB in any three subjects. For the grant competition (financial support) the NIS Grade 12 category requires not less than ABB in any three subjects, and the NUET route requires 120 total with at least 50 in each of Mathematics and Critical Thinking & Problem Solving.
value.value: NIS Grade 12: BBB (regular admission) / ABB (grant competition); NUET 120 (50 min per subject) for state grant

gpa.quote: A-level/NIS 12 Grade Certificate results not less than BBB for any three subjects
gpa.how_found: Same Regular Admissions page -> 'Admission Requirements' > 'Undergraduate' > 'Academic Results (one of the results)'. Quote is two adjacent table lines joined with a space. Financial-support thresholds from the Financial aid & Scholarships page (link 'Financial Aid & Scholarships' in the admissions menu).
gpa.notes: Other regular-admission lines on the same page: 'GPA – 4.0 out of 5.0', 'Other grading scales shall be converted to a GPA 5.0 scale for equivalency.', 'UNT in English Overall score: 85 Mathematical literacy: 8 out of 10 Reading literacy: 8 out of 10', 'Digital SAT: 1240 or ACT: 26', 'IB Diploma results: 27 total score and 4, 4, 4 for 3 subjects of HL', 'Only final A-level/NIS Grade 12 Certificates are considered.' Grant competition (Financial aid & Scholarships page, https://nu.edu.kz/admissions/how-to-apply/foundation-undergraduate/financial-aid-end-scholarships/): 'A-level/NIS 12 Grade Certificate results: not less than ABB for any three subjects'; 'Minimum passing score to be eligible for a state grant – 120 in total for two subjects, while the minimum passing score for each of the subjects is 50.'; 'Final Certificates issued in 2025 and 2026 are accepted for admission to the 2027–2028 academic year.'; SAT/ACT category for financial support is marked '(ONLY FOR INTERNATIONAL APPLICANTS)'. FAQ: 'Minimum GPA requirements are listed in the regular admission section. These requirements are not considered in the competition for financial aid and/or scholarships.' and 'The grants are not allocated by categories. All applicants are considered equally, regardless of the chosen category.' Foundation Year: GPA 3.5/5.0, UNT 75 (7/10, 7/10), Digital SAT 1140 / ACT 24.

deadline.quote: Please note that the application period for the NUET Applicants category is from September 27 to November 20, 2025 (until 14:00, Astana time).
deadline.how_found: nu.edu.kz Admissions > Announcements listing (https://nu.edu.kz/admissions/announcements/) -> 'Information for NUET Applicants category'. 2027/28 status from WebSearch '"2027–2028 academic year" NUFYP Undergraduate Programs application period now open' -> news item https://nu.edu.kz/news-en/the-application-period-for-the-nufyp-and-undergraduate-programs-for-the-2027-2028-academic-year-is-now-open/
deadline.notes: THIS DATE IS FROM THE PREVIOUS (2026/27) CYCLE, NOT THE 2027/28 INTAKE. For the autumn 2027 intake the university has not published a deadline: the 12 Oct 2026 notice says 'Application Deadlines: TBA (To Be Announced)' and 'Exact dates will be published on the University website under the section “ Regular Admission – Important Dates ”.' The Regular Admissions page 'Important Dates' gives only a window: 'Application submission to Foundation and Undergraduate programs: on a rolling basis' and 'For the 2027–2028 academic year: For citizens of Kazakhstan and international applicantsfrom countries eligible for visa issuance upon arrival : October 2026 – August 2027'; international applicants from countries requiring a visa before entry: to be announced. Financial-support (grant) categories, Financial aid page: 'NUET Applicants (NUFYP and Undergraduate programs, including international applicants) : October 2026 – To be announced later' and 'Other Categories (Undergraduate programs only: SAT/ACT, IB Diploma, A-level/NIS Grade 12 Certificate, Olympiad winners) : October 2026 – To be announced later'; 'Dates of NUET 2027 To be announced later'; last SAT/ACT test dates for financial support: SAT 05.12.2026, ACT 28.11.2026. Previous-cycle companion deadline: 'Upload valid IELTS/TOEFL iBT results via your Personal Account by December 8, 2025, 11:59 PM (Astana time).' Mid-year (spring 2027, fee-paying only) intake deadline: November 28, 2026, 14:00 Astana time; such applicants 'do not participate in selection for awarding an educational grant “NU” and other grants.' Application fee 10,000 tenge (30,000 in the last two weeks before the first deadline).

value.kzt_equivalent_note: residents pay in KZT at the University's internal rate of 486 KZT per 1 USD (= 7,290,000 KZT at that rate)
value.covered_by: State educational grant / “Nazarbayev University” Grant for applicants who win the merit competition (e.g. NUET ≥120 with ≥50 per subject, or other financial-support categories); regular admission is fee-paying

tuition.quote: The tuition fee for undergraduate programs is $15,000 for the 2026/2027 academic year for both local and international students.
tuition.how_found: Regular Admissions page -> 'Tuition Fees' tab -> 'Undergraduate'. KZT rate from WebSearch 'Nazarbayev University undergraduate tuition fee grant scholarship international applicants' -> 'Fees and financial support' page. Grant model from FAQ (https://nu.edu.kz/other/frequently-asked-questions/) and Financial aid page.
tuition.notes: No 2027/28 figure could be verified on a readable official page; a search-engine snippet of apply.nu.edu.kz/en/admissions reportedly gives $15,000 (7 665 000 KZT) for 2027/2028, but that page (Tilda, JS-rendered) returned 404/empty to fetchers, so it is NOT recorded. Fees and financial support page (https://nu.edu.kz/admissions/fees-and-funding/): 'Tuition fees for one academic year: Undergraduate programs $15,000' and '*For residents of the Republic of Kazakhstan, payments are processed in the national currency at the internal exchange rate of 486 KZT per 1 USD , as approved by the University.' Grant coverage: FAQ: 'An applicant participates in the competition for the award of the state grant according to the number allocated annually by the MSHE of the Republic of Kazakhstan. Quotas for other grants are determined by the university.' and '556 grants were allocated in 2024. The number of state grants is determined by the MSHE of the Republic of Kazakhstan. NU-funded grants depend on University capacity. Grants are distributed by ranking based on entry exam scores.' Policy PDF: 'Grant – a target amount of money provided to an Applicant/Student from different sources of funding to pay for studying at the University'. Grant is not automatic: 'Please note that regular admissions is classified as a full tuition-based category, implying fee-paying study' (Financial aid page); 'Financial aid is not provided to applicants who apply to a fee-paying study' (Fees page). Citizens educated on a state grant must work in Kazakhstan for at least three years after graduation (FAQ, Law On Education art. 47 §17). Partial discounts on the Fees page: 75% for socially vulnerable citizens (orphans, persons with disability I–III or whose parents have such disability), 25% for Olympiad winners, 25% for second and subsequent children of one family, 50% for government employees, 5% for single advance payment. Foundation Year tuition: $12,000 for 2026/2027.

scholarship_exists.quote: Nazarbayev University offers the “Abay Kunanbayev” scholarship for international candidates, who successfully go through the selection process and are recommended for admission by the Admissions Committee of the respective program.
scholarship_exists.how_found: WebSearch 'Nazarbayev University undergraduate tuition fee grant scholarship international applicants' -> results 'FAQ - Nazarbayev University' and 'General Information' (international admission) -> FAQ section 'Are there any scholarships available for international candidates to study at Nazarbayev University?'
scholarship_exists.notes: University-run, merit-based, no separate application: 'In order to be considered for the “Abay Kunanbayev” or the citizenship-based scholarships of the University, international candidates should apply to the program(s) of their interest, go through the selection process and be recommended for admission by the Admissions Committee of the respective program.' Coverage: 'This scholarship covers the tuition fee, basic medical insurance and the monthly stipend.' It is reserved for international candidates, so the DOMESTIC applicant in this case is not eligible for it; the domestic route is the state educational grant / “Nazarbayev University” Grant competed for through the financial-support categories (NUET, Olympiad winners, IB, A-level/NIS Grade 12). Policy PDF (№ 38-н/қ, 11.03.2026): 'Applicants applying for Undergraduate program in the Spring semester on a fee-paying basis and recommended for admission do not participate in selection for awarding an “Nazarbayev University” Grant, or other Grants/scholarships during admission and enrollment.' and 'Procedures of international Applicants' consideration for Grants are established according to the internal documents of the University.' Also on the international page (https://nu.edu.kz/admissions/international-admission/international-admission_general/): 'There are merit-based Abay Kunanbayev scholarships available for top international candidates, as recommended by the admissions committee of each school. This scholarship covers the tuition fee, medical insurance, and a monthly stipend.'

scholarship_international.quote: There are merit-based Abay Kunanbayev scholarships available for top international candidates, as recommended by the admissions committee of each school.
scholarship_international.how_found: Same search -> 'General Information - Nazarbayev University' (International Admission) -> section 'Scholarships and bursaries for international students' > 'Abai Scholarship'.
scholarship_international.notes: Open to international (non-citizen) applicants only; it is not offered to citizens of Kazakhstan. FAQ adds: 'In addition to the “Abay Kunanbayev” scholarship, international candidates who are recommended for admission are also eligible for the partial scholarships of the University based on their citizenship. The citizenship-based scholarships cover from 50 to 90% of the tuition fee.' and 'The monthly stipend is the same for all students of the University regardless of their citizenship.' International applicants otherwise meet the same entry requirements ('Admission to Nazarbayev University is merit-based. Thus, the entry requirements for the programs are the same for all candidates, regardless of their citizenship'); differences: SAT/ACT financial-support category is for international applicants only; deadlines may differ ('Application deadlines for each program for international candidates may differ from deadlines for candidates from Kazakhstan.'); accommodation is guaranteed for international students.

access_notes: admissions.nu.edu.kz is the application login portal only (Registration / Sign Up); it publishes no requirements, so all requirements were taken from nu.edu.kz admissions pages.

seds.nu.edu.kz (Tilda-hosted) returned HTTP 403 on the root and HTTP 404 on /bachelor_of_scs and /about_us to both WebFetch and curl with a browser user-agent; old-seds.nu.edu.kz returned empty/404. The programme is now published at scai.nu.edu.kz/bsc-cs (School of Computing and Artificial Intelligence), which loaded normally.

apply.nu.edu.kz/en/admissions (Tilda, JavaScript-rendered) returned HTTP 404 / an empty JS shell to WebFetch and curl; its reported 2027/2028 tuition figure ($15,000 = 7 665 000 KZT) and a 'November 28, 2026' date seen only in a search-engine snippet could not be verified and are not recorded as values.
Legacy nu.edu.kz URLs (/en/academics/school/..., /en/academics/program/...) return 404; the live catalogue is https://nu.edu.kz/admissions/programs/.

The WebFetch summarizer caps quotes at 125 characters and paraphrases, so verbatim quotes were taken from the raw HTML via curl with tags stripped; where a requirement is split over several table lines (e.g. the IELTS block, the NIS line) the lines were joined with single spaces.

The Admission Policy and Procedures PDF (№ 38-н/қ, approved 11.03.2026, effective 27.09.2025) was parsed with PyMuPDF after WebFetch returned only the binary stream; its clauses on 'Grants' refer to 'internal documents of the University' for international applicants and do not themselves state citizenship eligibility.

The announcement 'The extension of the deadline for submitting online applications to the Undergraduate and Foundation Programs for international applicants!' returned no readable content on fetch, so the previous-cycle international extension date is not recorded.

For the autumn 2027 intake the university states the application deadlines are TBA; the deadline value recorded is the previous (2026/27) cycle's NUET-category date, as instructed, and is flagged in notes.
